remarks: **HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DUE MONDAY 6/9 at 5pm.*Tucked at the end of a cul-de-sac, 6 Rivergate Woods welcomes you with a delightful front porch and mature landscaping that sets the tone for what's inside - starting with a spacious foyer, a sunny living room, private office/bedroom, a full bathroom, and the expansive family room. Sunlight pours into the living room, highlighting hardwood floors, the wood-burning fireplace, and a vaulted ceiling that enhances the feeling of space. The layout flows into the dining area and to the kitchen, featuring an island, SS appliances, glass cabinetry, and ample counter space. Pass by the laundry room to the oversized family room, where glass sliders open to the screened-in porch, an ideal spot for morning coffee while listening to the gentle sounds of nature. Upstairs, you'll find 3 generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The picture window and large balcony in the primary bedroom will make you feel at one with nature here. Picture exploring the woods, hosting neighborhood basketball games, and having outdoor parties on your little slice of paradise. Wilton offers the best of both worlds: a scenic, small-town atmosphere with convenient access to everything you need. With top-rated public schools, an active community center, beautiful hiking trails, and a walkable town center, Wilton continues to be one of Fairfield County's most desirable towns.
